prompts.pad-light: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE production-ready raster UI skin asset, not a complete interface. Transparent outside the rounded square. Flat thin geometry, not a tall mechanical button. Surface: luminous smooth white anodized titanium, cold pearlescent satin reflections, top left near-white, center pale silver #e0edf5, lower area pale icy blue #c5dfef. Extremely subtle microscopic irregular surface, NO brushed stripes. A precise ultra-thin chrome edge with a cyan-white luminous seam, stronger local light at lower left and right top, a tiny concentrated cyan bloom. Rich delicate optical reflections and realistic soft cyan bounce inside the surface, not a simple vector gradient. Low contrast calm center completely empty for real HTML text. No text, no numbers, no symbols, no screws, no neighboring objects, no background, no watermark.
